verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly cover Account Takeover, Account Abuse (fake accounts), Promotion Abuse, and Payment Protection all scored/managed within the same Events/Score/Decisions/Workflows system, indicating unified handling of multiple fraud surfaces beyond checkout. Community evidence corroborates real-world use for fraud signals and workflow-based review, though it's mostly first-party docs with limited independent verification of account-takeover/promo-abuse specifics in practice. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of account-takeover and promo-abuse detection accuracy, and more detail on cross-surface unified scoring beyond marketing pages.
